description: This file is a TypeScript script that analyzes source code to find specific call expressions related to ingress agent commands, particularly focusing on 'agentCommand' calls in designated source files or directories. It exports functions to locate these call lines and executes a main routine that runs a call site guard with specific parameters.

methods.name: findLegacyAgentCommandCallLines
methods.description: Analyzes provided source content to find call expressions where the callee is 'agentCommand', returning their line numbers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Orchestrates the analysis by running the callsite guard over specified source roots and enforced files.
